title: 第1615章 大荒后裔
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林风眼神纠结。

他想不到有办法能一分钟杀死蓬莱仙鹤。

因为他已经是世界第一强者。

就算现在全世界人都达到8重天境界。

他也有把握，自己会是最强的那个。

他能提升的东西，已经很少很少了。

身为皇朝皇帝，他有玉玺和封神榜。

有这两样帮忙他才能稳稳控住仙鹤，并且打掉他四分之一血量。

那其他玩家呢？

【看来，注定很多人会止步8重天。】

林风想了一圈。

能提升实力的办法已经很少了。

如果能提升到帝国，开国玉玺，封神榜，全都能升到帝国级，可能干过仙鹤。

可…帝国升级也很难啊！

【技能，装备。。能想到的，只有这些了！】

他的装备虽然在全世界已经最顶级了。

但是还有很大提升空间。

好多6重天的装备。

以前林风觉得无所谓，毕竟他已经世界第一了。

现在看来不行。

【不知道这里有没有装备！】

林风又回到小河村，村子里有铁匠和裁缝，正好可以问一下。

确实他们也在卖。

可当看到卖的东西，他直接无语了。

【锄头】【装备等级：1级】

【攻击力+1】

【装备后可以松土，种植药物。】

【蓑笠】【装备等级：1级】

【防御力+1】

【装备后可以轻度遮挡雨水，视野+1。】

没任何一样是有用的。

他们是真的在这里生活啊。

林风很是无奈，转悠了一圈，始终没有找到有用的信息。

【如果能搞到白老头的开国玉玺，攻击力肯定能提升。】

开国玉玺有个很BUG的设定。

他算法宝，但是，身为皇帝的林风，大商的开国玉玺和封神榜不占据法宝位置。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Feng's eyes were tangled.

He couldn't think of a way to kill Penglai Crane in one minute.

Because he is already the strongest person in the world.

Even now people all over the world have reached the 8th level of heaven.

He is also confident that he will be the strongest one.

There are very few things he can improve.

As the emperor of the dynasty, he has a jade seal and a list of gods.

With the help of these two things, he could steadily control the crane and knock out a quarter of his health.

What about other players?

[It seems that many people are destined to stop at the eighth level.】

Lin Feng thought for a while.

There are very few ways to improve your strength.

If he could be promoted to the empire level, the Jade Seal of the Founding of the People's Republic of China, the List of Gods, etc. could all be promoted to the imperial level, he might be able to defeat the crane.

But... it’s hard to upgrade the empire!

[Skills, equipment..That's all I can think of!】

Although his equipment is already the best in the world.

But there is still a lot of room for improvement.

A lot of 6th level equipment.

In the past, Lin Feng thought it didn't matter, after all, he was already number one in the world.

It seems not possible now.

[I wonder if there is any equipment here!】

Lin Feng returned to Xiaohe Village. There was a blacksmith and a tailor in the village, so he could ask about them.

Indeed they are selling it too.

But when he saw what was for sale, he was speechless.

[Hoe] [Equipment Level: Level 1]

[Attack power +1]

[After equipped, you can loosen the soil and plant medicine.】

[Coirella] [Equipment Level: Level 1]

[Defense +1]

[After equipped, it can slightly block the rain, and the field of view is +1.】

None of it is useful.

They really live here.

Lin Feng was helpless and wandered around, but still couldn't find any useful information.

[If you can get Old Man Bai’s founding jade seal, your attack power will definitely increase.】

Founding Jade Seal has a very buggy setting.

He calculated the magic weapon, but as the emperor Lin Feng, the founding jade seal of Dashang and the list of gods did not occupy the position of magic weapon.
